title: Constrained Synthesis with Projected Diffusion Models
summary:
This paper introduces an approach to endow generative diffusion processes the
ability to satisfy and certify compliance with constraints and physical
principles. The proposed method recast the traditional sampling process of
generative diffusion models as a constrained optimization problem, steering the
generated data distribution to remain within a specified region to ensure
adherence to the given constraints. These capabilities are validated on
applications featuring both convex and challenging, non-convex, constraints as
well as ordinary differential equations, in domains spanning from synthesizing
new materials with precise morphometric properties, generating physics-informed
motion, optimizing paths in planning scenarios, and human motion synthesis.
